chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad ibn Usman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) called for a parchment when death approached him, intending to forbid certain names by which one is named. So he was taken (in death) and did not specify them. Among them are Al-Hakam, Hakeem, Khalid, and Malik; and he mentioned that there are six or seven of those that are not permissible to be named with.
ai.seo_question: What are the specific names the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) forbade to be used for naming children?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) intended to issue a decree prohibiting specific divine names for humans to prevent confusion with Allah's unique attributes, but he passed away before finalizing the list. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the theological precision of naming, where names like Al-Hakam (The Judge) and Al-Khalid (The Eternal) are restricted to God alone, preserving the distinction between the Creator and the created.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that

Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> called for a parchment, when the death presented itself, intending that he<sup>saww</sup> would forbid from the names which are named by. So he<sup>saww</sup> passed away and did not name these. From these (forbidden names) are – Al-Hakam, and Hakeem, and Khalid, and Maalik’; and he<sup>asws</sup> mentioned that there are six or seven from what is not allowed that one should name with’.
en.sarwar: 14. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the Messenger of Allah asked for a sahifah (a book) and he (the Messenger of Allah) wanted to prohibit the use of certain names to use. He (the Messenger of Allah) passed away but he (the Messenger of Allah) did not mention them. Of such names are al- Hakam and Hakim, Khalid and Malik. He (the Imam) said that such names are six or seven and it is not permissible to use them.’”
